title: Netflix and BBC Come Together to Bring CBeebies to More Families
summary: A curated selection of programmes from the UK’s favourite and most-trusted pre-school brand CBeebies, will now be available on Netflix as part of a new partnership to test new ways to reach audiences.
body_markdown:
A curated selection of programmes from the UK’s favourite and most-trusted pre-school brand CBeebies, will now be available on Netflix as part of a new partnership to test new ways to reach audiences.


The BBC and Netflix are announcing a trial with a CBeebies branded hub on Netflix in the UK, Ireland, the US, Canada and Australia from


2


December.


The dedicated hub features a curated selection of programmes from the CBeebies brand, with BBC iPlayer remaining the home for all CBeebies content.


Featuring the much-loved CBeebies characters from 24 selected programmes, the partnership will explore whether making a sample of high-quality content available on Netflix can extend CBeebies’ reach and visibility.


The announcement forms part of the BBC’s strategy to test and learn with new ways to find audiences where they are, assessing off platform impact on reach and attribution back to the BBC. It will also generate insight into audience behaviour, discoverability and engagement, helping the BBC understand how off-platform visibility can bring distinctive home-grown content to more people.


Netflix already includes the likes of


Shaun the Sheep


and


Hey Duggee


, and the collaboration to bring some CBeebies favourites into the Netflix service offers parents further peace of mind, knowing their kids will be entertained, engaged and enriched with trusted content.


The partnership will also extend globally bringing the CBeebies brand experience to Netflix members outside the UK in a distribution deal managed by BBC Studios. It also aims to drive investment into children’s content in the UK, with Netflix committing to funding a small number of new CBeebies commissions.


BBC’s Chief Content Officer Kate Phillips says:


"The BBC has some of the world's most loved content and brands, and we're always looking at how we can help more audiences discover them. This limited trial will make a curated selection of CBeebies programmes available on Netflix, while BBC iPlayer remains the home of the full CBeebies experience. It's an opportunity to learn more about how partnerships can help us extend the reach of our content, which is already appreciated by millions across the UK every day, deliver greater value for audiences and champion outstanding British creativity."


Patricia Hidalgo, Director of BBC Children’s and Education says:


“CBeebies has been part of family life for generations, offering distinctive, trusted programmes made with children at their heart. While BBC iPlayer remains the home of the full CBeebies experience, viewing habits are changing. This trial with Netflix will showcase a taster of what we offer and help promote brilliant UK children’s content.”


Anne Mensah, VP of UK Content, Netflix said:


“CBeebies holds a special and unrivalled place in the hearts of UK families and we are delighted to bring that love to all our Netflix homes in the UK and beyond. This unique partnership allows us to work hand in hand with the BBC to support our brilliant British kids' programme makers. We want to build a fun and safe space parents can feel good about, with content their kids will love.”


The CBeebies hub will launch on Netflix on 2 December featuring


Hey Duggee, Numberblocks and Teletubbies.
